items.title: ZDI-CAN-31451: VMware
items.description: A CVSS score 8.8 AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H severity vulnerability discovered by 'Gwangun Jung (@pr0ln) of Theori, with Xint Code' was reported to the affected vendor on: 2026-07-07, 0 days ago.
